requirements.description: AI Providers appears as top-level navigation item in sidebar
steps: Open the application sidebar
Verify 'AI Providers' appears in top-level navigation list
Confirm icon is appropriate (e.g., brain/robot icon)
Click AI Providers to navigate to the section
Verify current route is /ai-providers

requirements.description: AI Providers has sub-navigation for LLM, Image, Speech, and Usage
steps: Navigate to /ai-providers
Verify sidebar shows sub-pages: LLM, Image, Speech, Usage
Click each sub-page and verify correct route loads
Confirm sub-page icons are appropriate for each type
Verify active sub-page is highlighted in sidebar

requirements.description: Settings no longer contains AI Providers tab
steps: Navigate to /settings
Verify AI Providers tab is not present
Confirm remaining tabs: Preferences, Branding, Data
Attempt to access /settings/ai URL directly
Verify redirect to /ai-providers occurs

requirements.description: Speech providers table created with proper schema
steps: Review database schema file
Verify speech_providers table exists
Confirm columns: id, type, name, apiKey, baseUrl, createdAt, updatedAt
Verify type is constrained to 'elevenlabs'
Check foreign key relationships are properly defined

requirements.description: Speech voices table created with ElevenLabs settings
steps: Review database schema file
Verify speech_voices table exists
Confirm columns include voiceId, name, isActive, settings JSON
Verify settings JSON supports: stability, similarityBoost, style, useSpeakerBoost
Check providerId foreign key references speech_providers

requirements.description: AI usage logs table created for granular tracking
steps: Review database schema file
Verify ai_usage_logs table exists
Confirm columns: id, providerType, providerId, modelOrVoiceId, operationType
Verify columns include: tokensOrCharacters, cost, timestamp, metadata JSON
Check operationType enum includes: 'text', 'image', 'speech'

requirements.description: Drizzle migrations generated for new tables
steps: Run drizzle-kit generate command
Verify migration files created for speech_providers table
Verify migration files created for speech_voices table
Verify migration files created for ai_usage_logs table
Confirm journal.json updated with new migration entries

requirements.description: LLM Providers page displays configured providers
steps: Navigate to /ai-providers/llm
Verify page loads with dashboard layout
Confirm list of configured LLM providers is displayed
Verify each provider shows name, type, and active model
Check that status indicators show provider health

requirements.description: LLM Providers page supports adding new providers
steps: Navigate to /ai-providers/llm
Click 'Add Provider' button
Verify modal opens with provider type selection
Select a provider type (e.g., OpenAI)
Configure API key and save
Verify new provider appears in list

requirements.description: LLM Providers page supports model management
steps: Navigate to /ai-providers/llm
Click on a configured provider
Verify model management interface opens
Click 'Add Model' and select from discovered models
Set a model as active
Verify active model indicator updates

requirements.description: Image Providers page displays image-capable providers
steps: Navigate to /ai-providers/image
Verify page loads with dashboard layout
Confirm providers with purpose='image' models are listed
Verify each shows name, type, and active image model
Check visual distinction from LLM providers

requirements.description: Image Providers page supports image model configuration
steps: Navigate to /ai-providers/image
Verify image-specific providers shown (Replicate, FAL, etc.)
Click 'Configure' on a provider
Add an image generation model
Set an image model as active
Verify image generation uses active model

requirements.description: Speech Providers page displays ElevenLabs configuration
steps: Navigate to /ai-providers/speech
Verify page loads with dashboard layout
Confirm ElevenLabs provider section is visible
Verify API key input field for ElevenLabs
Check voice management section is present

requirements.description: Speech Providers page supports voice discovery and management
steps: Navigate to /ai-providers/speech
Enter valid ElevenLabs API key
Click 'Discover Voices' button
Verify voice list populates from ElevenLabs API
Select voices to enable
Verify enabled voices appear in voice list

requirements.description: Speech voice settings can be configured
steps: Navigate to /ai-providers/speech
Click on an enabled voice
Verify voice settings panel opens
Adjust stability slider (0.0 to 1.0)
Adjust similarity boost slider (0.0 to 1.0)
Save settings and verify persistence

requirements.description: Active speech voice can be selected
steps: Navigate to /ai-providers/speech
Enable multiple voices
Click 'Set Active' on a voice
Verify active indicator moves to selected voice
Test speech generation uses active voice
Verify voice settings are applied in generation

requirements.description: Usage page displays historical usage data
steps: Navigate to /ai-providers/usage
Verify page loads with dashboard layout
Confirm usage statistics are displayed
Verify date range selector is present
Check data aggregates across all provider types

requirements.description: Usage page shows charts for provider usage
steps: Navigate to /ai-providers/usage
Verify chart component renders usage over time
Confirm chart shows LLM token usage
Verify chart shows Image generation count
Check chart shows Speech character usage
Verify tooltips show detailed breakdown on hover

requirements.description: Usage page supports filtering by provider and date
steps: Navigate to /ai-providers/usage
Select date range (Last 7 days, 30 days, Custom)
Verify chart updates for selected range
Filter by specific provider type (LLM only)
Verify data filters correctly
Clear filters and verify all data returns

requirements.description: Usage tracking captures granular per-call data
steps: Perform an LLM text generation
Verify entry created in ai_usage_logs table
Check tokens used and cost are recorded
Generate an image and verify log entry
Generate speech and verify character count logged
Verify all entries have accurate timestamps

requirements.description: API routes exist for speech providers
steps: Verify GET /api/ai-providers/speech endpoint exists
Check POST /api/ai-providers/speech for creating provider
Verify PATCH /api/ai-providers/speech/:id for updates
Confirm DELETE /api/ai-providers/speech/:id endpoint
Test GET /api/ai-providers/speech/voices for voice discovery

requirements.description: API routes exist for usage data
steps: Verify GET /api/ai-providers/usage endpoint exists
Check query params support date range filtering
Verify response includes aggregated data by provider type
Confirm endpoint supports time bucket parameter (daily/hourly)
Test data is properly aggregated from ai_usage_logs

requirements.description: API routes exist for speech voice management
steps: Verify GET /api/ai-providers/speech/voices endpoint
Check POST /api/ai-providers/speech/voices for adding voice
Verify PATCH /api/ai-providers/speech/voices/:id for settings
Confirm POST /api/ai-providers/speech/voices/:id/activate endpoint
Test DELETE /api/ai-providers/speech/voices/:id for removal

requirements.description: SpeechProviderCard component displays voice information
steps: Review SpeechProviderCard.vue component
Verify it displays provider name and type
Confirm voice count is shown
Check active voice is highlighted
Verify ElevenLabs branding/icon is present

requirements.description: SpeechVoiceSettings component allows configuration
steps: Review SpeechVoiceSettings.vue component
Verify stability slider with 0.0-1.0 range
Confirm similarity boost slider present
Check style slider and use speaker boost toggle
Verify preview button plays voice sample

requirements.description: UsageChart component renders interactive charts
steps: Review UsageChart.vue component
Verify chart library integration (e.g., Chart.js)
Confirm multi-series support for different provider types
Check hover tooltips show detailed data
Verify responsive design for different screen sizes

requirements.description: ProviderSwitcher component updated for new structure
steps: Review ProviderSwitcher.vue in sidebar
Verify it still shows active text and image models
Check if speech voice selector is added
Confirm quick-switch functionality works
Verify component reflects changes from new provider pages

requirements.description: Existing LLM and Image providers migrate automatically
steps: Review migration strategy in code
Verify existing ai_providers data remains intact
Confirm ai_models relationships are preserved
Test application starts without data loss
Verify existing configurations work in new location

requirements.description: Settings AI page redirects to new location
steps: Attempt to navigate to /settings/ai
Verify redirect to /ai-providers occurs
Check URL updates correctly in browser
Verify no 404 errors occur
Confirm settings tabs show correct remaining items

requirements.description: ElevenLabs API integration works for voice discovery
steps: Enter valid ElevenLabs API key
Click discover voices button
Verify API call to ElevenLabs /v1/voices endpoint
Confirm voice list is populated with available voices
Check error handling for invalid API key
Verify network error messages are user-friendly

requirements.description: ElevenLabs API integration works for speech generation
steps: Configure active voice with settings
Trigger speech generation in app
Verify API call to ElevenLabs /v1/text-to-speech
Confirm voice settings are passed in request
Check audio file is received and playable
Verify usage is logged to ai_usage_logs

requirements.description: API keys are stored securely for speech providers
steps: Review storage mechanism for ElevenLabs API key
Verify key is encrypted at rest (if secure storage available)
Check API key is never logged in plain text
Confirm key is not exposed in client-side code
Verify key validation occurs server-side only

requirements.description: Usage data does not contain sensitive information
steps: Review ai_usage_logs table schema
Verify no API keys or credentials are stored
Check metadata JSON doesn't include sensitive data
Confirm logs only contain operational metrics
Verify access to usage data is properly authorized

requirements.description: Usage data queries are optimized with indexes
steps: Review ai_usage_logs table indexes
Verify index on timestamp column for time-range queries
Check index on providerType for filtering
Confirm composite index for common query patterns
Test query performance with large dataset

requirements.description: Usage charts load data efficiently
steps: Navigate to usage page
Select 30-day date range
Verify chart data loads within 2 seconds
Check server aggregates data appropriately
Confirm client-side rendering is optimized
